en.title: Vowel-Only Substrings Containing All Five Vowels
en.description:
Count all contiguous substrings that contain only aeiou and in which each of the five vowels appears at least once, and output the exact integer.

The input/output protocol was compiled independently by this site; upstream solutions are not executed.
en.input: One line containing a string over a..z of length 1..100000.
en.output: Output the single integer required by the problem.
en.explanation: The answers to the three public examples are, in order: 1; 4; 3. All examples have been verified by independent small-scale enumeration or state search.
hints: Track the most recent position of each of the five vowels and the most recent consonant position; for each right end, the number of valid starts is min(most recent vowel positions)−most recent consonant position, taking 0 if negative.
